added: When you are signed in, the theme and the language you choose are saved to your anotoki account, so every anotoki site uses them - and dates and times are written the way your account says

Your progress file: at the end of Stats you can download your progress as a file, and bring it back from one - on another computer, for example. If you already have progress, the app asks before it replaces it
Piano Academy in Slovak: choose the language with the button at the top of the page

For administrators: the menu's "Admin panel" opens the admin panel - Translations, Languages, People, and Migrations: the database's updates, waiting and applied, and a button to apply them, even while the app waits for one
If Piano Academy lets you practise without signing in, your progress is kept for this browser for 30 days after your last visit - and when you sign in, it comes with you into your account
updated: You always sign in with your anotoki account now, on your own computer too: open any page, and the app takes you to the sign-in and back to that page

One bar at the top of every page, as on the other anotoki sites: Learn, Note Trainer, Sheet Practice, Songs and Stats, then your piano, the language, the theme and your menu. On a phone or a small window they are behind the menu button
Your piano is a small button in the bar - a green dot when it is connected. Press it to choose the device, connect or look for devices again
"Not saved yet" now shows in the bar (on a phone, as a dot on the menu button), and signing out asks first if some of your progress could not be saved
If your progress was replaced or deleted somewhere else (another tab or another computer), the page loads it again and tells you - also in the middle of a round - so an old page never saves over it

added: Sign in with your anotoki account on the website, piano.anotoki.eu - your progress is saved to your account and waits for you on any computer
On your own computer the app still needs no sign-in, and a setup page asks for the database the first time
A light and a dark look - press the theme button at the bottom of the page to choose, or let your computer decide
The app works on phones and small screens too
This list of what is new: press the version number at the bottom of the page
updated: The whole app has been rebuilt from the ground up - the same lessons, Note Trainer, Sheet Practice, Songs and Stats, on a new base that is ready for the left hand, both hands and chords
Your progress is kept in a database instead of files - everything you practised before is still there
If a save does not get through (no internet, the server is away), the app says "Not saved yet" and keeps trying, and a finished round waits in your browser until it arrives
The note you should play now is coloured on the staff, not only its stem
